model_annotation: The grouped bar chart illustrates “effect” values across language families for six model/setting combinations, shown side by side within each family. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “family,” with labels ordered left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 10, 20, and 30 (the plotted range extends slightly below 0 and up to the mid-30s). For each family there are six colored bars with black error bars: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). In IE-Baltic, the bars are approximately 2 (mBERT-L₂), 1 (XLM-L₂), 3 (mBERT-R₂), 3 (XLM-R₂), 6 (mBERT-B₂), and 5 (XLM-B₂). In IE-Germanic, the light blue and blue bars are near 10 each, the two green bars are near 0 with small negative values, and the pink and red bars are around 15 each. In IE-Indic, the L₂ bars are near 1 and 0, the R₂ bars are around 20 (light green) and 18 (green), and the B₂ bars are around 24 (pink) and 21 (red). In IE-Romance, values are about 6 (light blue), 4 (blue), 5 (light green), 1 (green), 12–13 (pink), and 6 (red). In IE-Slavic, the L₂ bars are about 10–11 and 9, the R₂ bars are near 1 and 0, and the B₂ bars are around 17 (pink) and 16 (red). In IE-other, the L₂ bars are both about 6, the R₂ bars are near 0, and the B₂ bars are around 8 for both pink and red. In Isolate, all bars cluster close to 0, with small positive values around 1–2 for the green and pink/red bars and near-zero (slightly negative) for the light blue bar. In Semitic, the bars are approximately 11 (light blue), 16 (blue), about −2 (light green), about −1 (green), about 15 (pink), and about 19 (red), with comparatively large error bars visible for several series. In Uralic, all bars are small and near 0–2, with light blue and blue around 1, the green bars around 0.5, the pink bar around 1.5–2, and the red bar around 0.5–1; across the chart, each bar includes a vertical error bar with caps, and no bars appear specially highlighted beyond the legend-based color encoding.
